title: Entropy asymptotics for binomial tail sums
statement:
Fix a real number $\tau$ with $0 \le \tau \le \tfrac12$. Then the normalized base-$2$ logarithm of the lower binomial tail sum converges to the binary entropy of $\tau$:
\[
  \frac{1}{n}\log_2\!\left(\sum_{j=0}^{\lfloor \tau n\rfloor} \binom{n}{j}\right)
  \;\longrightarrow\; H(\tau)
  \qquad (n \to \infty).
\]
hypotheses_covered: limit taken as n → ∞ over natural numbers
